text.suptitle:
Ablation ladder: held-out $R^2$ of four predictions of the fine-tuned answer vectors, layer 25 (bars: mean over arms ± s.e.m.; points: per-arm; dashed lines: floor + ceiling means).
Default map convention (top-left): generic real-user contexts (LMSYS+WildChat, n=15,000 train), on-policy text in both models, span-mean pooling; other panels are variations against it
